task.title: Memory cleanup repairs intermittent malformed structured output
task.source: Direct user report plus repeated live Harlequin reproductions on the Raspberry Pi.

coreClaim: Memory cleanup uses the shared bounded structured-generation repair path when a provider declares malformed JSON complete, while preserving strict proposal validation and review-before-apply behavior.
rootCause: After the completion-budget repair, LinkAPI Gemini still intermittently returned syntactically incomplete JSON with finishReason=stop. Memory cleanup was the structured-generation outlier: it parsed the first response once and surfaced the raw JSON error instead of using De-Koi's bounded repair path.

inScope: Memory cleanup structured response parsing and bounded repair
Focused regression coverage for repeated malformed responses
outOfScope: Memory persistence or cleanup apply behavior
Chat, roleplay, or game generation prompts

claimBoundary.coreClaim: An intermittently malformed Harlequin cleanup response gets up to two bounded structured repair attempts, and only a complete proposals object reaches the existing validator.
entrypoints: Character Memories -> Tidy memories -> Analyze memories
legacyPathsOrFormats: Providers that ignore responseFormat still receive the exact JSON proposal schema in prompt text.
Providers that do not support adjustable reasoning still receive the larger output budget.
Valid fenced JSON with trailing provider text remains accepted.
Proposal validation and review-before-apply behavior remain unchanged.
positiveRowsTested: Existing valid fenced JSON proposal with trailing text
Two malformed responses followed by a valid bounded repair response
Two complete live ten-group Harlequin cleanup previews
negativeRowsTested: Unrelated memories excluded from the model request
Malformed JSON never reaches proposal normalization
groundTruthFacts: The failing live response had finishReason=length, 1,148 thought tokens, and 48 candidate tokens under the 1,200-token cap.
A post-deploy live response had finishReason=stop but ended mid-object at character 874.
Two patched full replays analyzed all ten live groups and produced review previews without applying proposals.
claimBoundary.userActionCopy: No new user action or copy is introduced.
outOfScopeClaims: This change does not alter which memories are selected as cleanup candidates.
This change does not bypass validation or apply any proposal automatically.
This change does not claim every provider will honor no-reasoning parameters.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: A provider could declare a syntactically incomplete memory-cleanup object complete, and the one-shot parser exposed a raw JSON error instead of using bounded structured repair.
contractLaneGate.consumer: Configured LLM provider followed by normalizeModelProposal
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: The producer must deliver one complete proposals object to the strict consumer or fail visibly without applying anything.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: Memory cleanup now uses generateStructured with the proposals-array schema and at most two repair attempts; only schema-valid JSON proceeds to the existing proposal validator.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: Mode-neutral engine generation owns memory cleanup prompt semantics and request parameters.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not infer missing JSON, loosen proposal validation, silently accept partial output, or apply anything before review.
regressionProof: src/engine/generation/memory-cleanup.spec.ts proves two malformed responses are rejected before a third valid response is accepted.
The existing fenced JSON with trailing text regression remains green.
Two full live Harlequin previews completed across all ten groups without applying proposals.

positiveRows.claim: The focused memory cleanup behavior remains correct.
positiveRows.evidence: The cleanup and structured-generation suites passed 15 tests, including repeated malformed responses, fenced JSON with trailing text, and strict proposal validation.

positiveRows.claim: The complete live analysis path can produce a safe preview.
positiveRows.evidence: Two sanitized full replays analyzed all ten Harlequin groups and returned seven preview proposals each; no apply command was issued.

positiveRows.claim: The TypeScript and architecture boundaries remain valid.
positiveRows.evidence: pnpm typecheck and pnpm check:architecture passed in the isolated worktree.

contradictionRows.claim: The fix must not accept incomplete JSON as success.
contradictionRows.evidence: Malformed JSON is rejected by generateStructured, receives at most two repair attempts, and still fails visibly if no complete proposals object is returned.

contradictionRows.claim: The fix must not alter memory records during analysis.
contradictionRows.evidence: Only analysis parsing/repair and shared fence extraction changed; storage and apply paths are untouched.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Providers that already returned valid JSON continue through the same parser and validator.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: Existing valid JSON and fenced JSON with trailing provider text regression tests still pass without a repair request.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Providers that ignore JSON mode still receive a complete textual schema.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT includes exact keep_one, combine, and conflict object shapes and exact reason strings.

untestedRows: The complete Harlequin browser flow will be rechecked after the follow-up merged build is deployed to the Pi; no proposal will be applied.

ownedFacts.description: Memory cleanup analysis is owned by the TypeScript engine and uses the shared LLM gateway without changing provider transport.
ownedFacts.evidence: src/engine/generation/memory-cleanup.ts imports only engine contracts, entities, and the LlmGateway capability.

ownedFacts.description: The existing validator requires sourceIds, a replacement object for combine proposals, and enumerated reason strings.

verification.baselineEvidence: The composite gate passed through check:frontend before the Windows harness stopped displaying the chain. Every remaining stage then passed separately: docs, Pi container distribution, Bunny guidance, PR-aware discovery, agent workflow, launcher safety, main protection, Rust workspace check, and the warning-only unused-code report.

notes: No user memory content is recorded in this ledger.
The PR remains unmerged until local checks, hosted CI, current-head Bunny, and PR health are clean.
